output.review_comment: Well-executed fix addressing three issues: (1) off-by-one error corrected in graduated pricing formula to account for inclusive tier ranges, (2) negative quantity validation per docstring requirements, and (3) bulk pricing implementation where quantities exceeding the last bounded tier apply the unbounded rate to all units. All 9 tests pass as claimed. Code is clear and well-documented. The bulk pricing behavior is a significant departure from traditional graduated pricing but appears to match the specification encoded in the test suite. Merge-ready.
